title: Display classification regions in PCA space
description: You fit a visualization model and classify a grid of projected positions.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You fit the visualization scaler and two-component PCA on all of X. The classifier then fits all projected rows Zv with their labels y.
You create a grid spanning the projected data with one-unit padding, using the supplied resolution. Flattening and stacking its coordinates produces rows for prediction.

steps.question: What shape must the prediction array have for the contour plot?
steps.answer: It must match xx1.shape, the two-dimensional grid. reshape places the flat list of grid predictions into that layout.

steps.description: You draw predicted class regions and overlay the observed projected points colored by y. The axes identify PC1 and PC2, the first two principal components.
